content:
New CI runs on pull requests will face this error until master is rebased / merged

Outdated cache tool
Your branch predates the cache storage-layout migration; merge master so lake exe cache get can read
your branch's artifacts.

With this...

...detailed error in the logs:

==============================================================================
ERROR: Your branch predates the cache storage-layout migration (PR #40035).
Its 'lake exe cache' tool uses outdated infrastructure, so it will miss the
artifacts CI builds for your branch and rebuild them locally instead.
Please merge 'master' into your PR branch and push again.

You can do this with:
git fetch upstream
git merge upstream/master
git push
==============================================================================

Please see #mathlib4 > Announcement: lake exe cache changes for forks and PRs for context on this requirement. Sorry for the disruption!
